document.title: Internationalization Notes — i18n
document.content:
# Internationalization 🌐

## Supported Languages

- English (en)
- Español (es)
- 日本語 (ja)
- العربية (ar) — RTL support
- 中文 (zh-Hans)

## Special Characters Test

- Curly quotes: “Hello” ‘world’
- Em dash: —
- Ellipsis: …
- Arrows: ← ↑ → ↓
- Math: ∀x ∈ S, ∃y : x ≠ y
- Zero-width joiner: 👨‍💻 (technologist)
- Null byte test: should not appear \u0000 in output
- Backslash: C:\\Users\\docs
